analysis:
Examined the Autopilot model-set expansion, coordinator-driven downloads, adoption and inventory changes. No supported regression was found.

Control (ProviderLoop+AutopilotControl.swift): runtime gates now use autopilotSetAllows and autopilotModelSet (head L19, L55, L89) instead of the persisted selection. All gates still require autopilotConsented, which excludes privateOnly (L8-10). Download settings are refreshed separately and change no consent, revision or lease (L76-83). Losing consent drops non-resident cached builds (L94; ModelSet L184-193).

Downloads (ProviderLoop+AutopilotDownload.swift): the coordinator, which is trusted, issues prefetch_model. The provider gates it on consent, download settings, pause, shutdown and drain (L48-68), plus reportable ID, runtime eligibility and the disk budget (L77-85). After download, the scan and WeightHasher run off the actor (L124-130). Consent, pause, loaded slot, eligibility, self-test and set-room checks are then repeated (L132-152) before the build joins the inventory and liveModelHashes (ModelSet L43-56). A build is never advertised at this stage.

The weight hash is still computed locally and self-reported. That is the pre-existing T-012/T-027/A-004 posture; it is not new.

Inventory: withdrawInactiveAutopilotModels now keeps validly adopted models advertised without a live lease (Inventory head L15). Validity is defined by autopilotAdoptionIsValid in ProviderLoop+AutopilotPlacement.swift. According to the file_changes excerpt, it requires consent, set membership, a resident slot, no retirement, no failed self-test and a live hash. That full source was not supplied (unit 7c6aec79be94397a:0 is metadata only), so this is a coverage limit.

Re-registration for new inventory goes through a planned reconnect only when the provider is idle (ModelSet L111-158). It does not touch TB-011 / T-053 authorization binding, but whether coordinator-side policy treats the grown selected_models correctly is outside the supplied evidence.

Open items for integration:
- The full Placement source: hold and adoption expiry and invalidation paths.
- AutopilotDownloadPrefetcher catalog and hash verification against the coordinator catalog.
- AutopilotDownloadLedger file permissions and integrity. The ledger only feeds budget accounting, so tampering is a local availability issue.
- AutopilotModelSet.effective and isReportableID bounds.
